# Synthetic PoE1 item copies

These fixtures are synthetic English PoE 3.2x-style examples, not client recordings.
Real owner recordings override them. No upstream item data is distributed here.
Each expected.json contains independently authored assertions, with common, plain,
and advanced objects. Objects assert the supplied fields; arrays assert exact contents.
Unspecified fields are intentionally unconstrained. New copies without expectations
are still discovered and must parse without error diagnostics.
Magic names cannot reliably reveal their base without a data pack: BaseType is null.
Unmarked prose is retained as OtherText when its meaning cannot be determined.
